title: ICAR Kharif Agro-Advisories for Farmers 2025: common rice diseases
excerpt_en: Brown spot can appear as oval or circular, dark-brown to purplish-brown spots with a greyish-white centre. Integrated management begins with healthy seed, field sanitation, balanced fertiliser, recommended cultural practices and water management.
excerpt_or: ବ୍ରାଉନ୍ ସ୍ପଟ୍ ଗୋଲ କିମ୍ବା ଅଣ୍ଡାକାର, ଗାଢ଼ ବାଦାମୀ ଦାଗ ଭଳି ଦେଖାଯାଇପାରେ ଏବଂ ମଝି ଧୂସର-ଧଳା ହୋଇପାରେ। ସମନ୍ୱିତ ପରିଚାଳନାରେ ସୁସ୍ଥ ବିହନ, କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ପରିଷ୍କାର, ସମତୁଳିତ ସାର ଏବଂ ଜଳ ପରିଚାଳନା ରହେ।

title: Blast (leaf and collar): distinguishing brown spot
publisher: International Rice Research Institute Rice Knowledge Bank
excerpt_en: Leaf blast lesions are usually elongated and pointed at each end, while brown spot lesions tend to be rounder, brown, and surrounded by a yellow halo.
excerpt_or: ପତ୍ର ବ୍ଲାଷ୍ଟର ଦାଗ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଲମ୍ବା ଏବଂ ଦୁଇ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ; ବ୍ରାଉନ୍ ସ୍ପଟ୍ ଦାଗ ଅଧିକ ଗୋଲ, ବାଦାମୀ ଏବଂ ଚାରିପାଖରେ ହଳଦିଆ ଘେର ଥାଇପାରେ।

title: Brown spot: identification
publisher: International Rice Research Institute Rice Knowledge Bank
excerpt_en: Brown spot is a fungal disease that infects leaves and other rice parts. Leaf lesions start small, circular, and dark brown to purple-brown. Fully developed lesions are circular to oval with a light brown to grey centre surrounded by a reddish-brown margin. On susceptible varieties lesions can be 5-14 mm long and can kill the whole leaf.
excerpt_or: ବ୍ରାଉନ୍ ସ୍ପଟ୍ ଏକ ଛତ୍ରକ ରୋଗ। ପତ୍ରରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଛୋଟ ଗୋଲ ଗାଢ଼ ବାଦାମୀ ଦାଗ ଦେଖାଯାଏ। ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଦାଗ ଗୋଲ କିମ୍ବା ଅଣ୍ଡାକାର, ମଝି ହାଲୁକା ବାଦାମୀ କିମ୍ବା ଧୂସର ହୋଇପାରେ।

title: Brown spot: soil fertility and resistant varieties
publisher: International Rice Research Institute Rice Knowledge Bank
excerpt_en: Improving soil fertility is the first step in managing brown spot. Monitor soil nutrients regularly, use resistant varieties where available, and keep fields clean. These are non-chemical, observation and field-care steps, with no product or dose recommendation here.
excerpt_or: ବ୍ରାଉନ୍ ସ୍ପଟ୍ ପରିଚାଳନାରେ ମାଟିର ଉର୍ବରତା ପ୍ରଥମ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ। ମାଟିର ପୋଷକ ନିୟମିତ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତିରୋଧୀ କିସମ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ପରିଷ୍କାର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

title: Narrow brown spot: distinguishing brown spot
publisher: International Rice Research Institute Rice Knowledge Bank
excerpt_en: Narrow brown spot lesions are usually light to dark brown, linear, and progress parallel to the vein, usually 2-10 mm long and 1-1.5 mm wide. This linear pattern differs from the rounder brown-spot pattern, so a linear pattern alone should not be treated as brown spot.
excerpt_or: ସଂକୀର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବ୍ରାଉନ୍ ସ୍ପଟ୍ ଦାଗ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ସିଧା ଏବଂ ଶିରା ସହିତ ସମାନ୍ତରାଳ, ଲମ୍ବା ୨-୧୦ ମିମି। ଏହା ଗୋଲ ବ୍ରାଉନ୍ ସ୍ପଟ୍ ଠାରୁ ଭିନ୍ନ।
